shelters.name: Charleston Animal Society
shelters.description: South Carolina's #1 Charity since 1874. Open-admissions shelter serving Charleston County. Currently caring for 1,300+ animals. Responds to animals in crisis from disasters.

shelters.name: Greenville Humane Society
shelters.description: One of the largest no-kill facilities in the Southeast. Works with community to create environment where all animals are treated with compassion and respect.

shelters.name: Humane Society of South Carolina
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) charitable organization. Mission to end animal cruelty, neglect, and overpopulation through low-cost spay/neuter and feral cat colony management.

shelters.name: Pet Helpers
shelters.description: No-kill shelter saving 57,000+ lives from euthanasia through adoption and fostering. Provides low-cost spay/neuter and humane education.

shelters.name: Hallie Hill Animal Sanctuary
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) sanctuary providing permanent home for abandoned, abused, or neglected animals. 30+ acres with large enclosures. Helps Charleston achieve no-kill status.

shelters.name: Dorchester Paws
shelters.description: Only open-admission shelter in Dorchester County. Part of No Kill South Carolina Coalition. Achieved 93% live release rate in 2021.

shelters.name: Columbia Animal Services
shelters.description: Only open admission shelter serving all pets and individuals in true need of shelter intervention within Richland County.

shelters.name: Humane Society of York County
shelters.description: Local nonprofit serving the greater Charlotte region including York, Lancaster, and Mecklenburg counties.

shelters.name: LowCountry Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization serving the Lowcountry region of coastal South Carolina.

shelters.name: Dusty Tails Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Animal rescue serving the Charleston area.

shelters.name: Cindy Lou's Sanctuary
shelters.description: Animal sanctuary serving Berkeley County in the Charleston metro area.

shelters.name: Spartanburg Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Spartanburg and the Upstate region of South Carolina.

shelters.name: Anderson County PAWS
shelters.description: Animal shelter serving Anderson County in the Upstate region.

shelters.name: Florence Area Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Florence and the Pee Dee region of South Carolina.

shelters.name: Beaufort County Animal Shelter
shelters.description: County animal shelter serving Beaufort County and the Lowcountry region.

notes: Comprehensive collection of South Carolina animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. Charleston Animal Society has served since 1874. Greenville Humane Society is one of the largest no-kill facilities in the Southeast. Dorchester Paws achieved 93% live release rate. Coverage spans Charleston, Columbia, Greenville, Spartanburg, and Lowcountry.
